name: qkd_d2d_p2_ref-q15-COMMIT
purpose: q13b-kvend: ot_qkvd_kv_end on the pin-registered link-buffer tiles (PQ=2, PF=1, HT=1), replacing qkd_d2d_ref-q10 (TT -134.7 / FF -215.8 / DRC 35 on the old sbuf child view). +1 cycle per link hop.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkvd_kv_end #(.QD(48), .UCX(48), .HT(1), .PF(1), .PQ(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_kv_end.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_d2d.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sb.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_buf_tiles_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: p2_ht_layer_exact
bench.cmd: PQ=2 PF=1 HT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh pos {RUN}/bench/ht_pos

bench.name: p2_ht_layer_mut
bench.cmd: PQ=2 PF=1 HT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/ht_neg 2

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_p2_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_p2_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_p2_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkvd_kv_end --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_fbuf8p_ref/views/ot_qkvd_fbuf8p --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_sbufp_ref/views/ot_qkvd_sbufp > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: link buffers replaced by the pin-registered M5-leaf tiles ot_qkvd_sbufp / ot_qkvd_fbuf8p (every face pin registered, pop registered per slice inside the tile) with ot_qkvd_d2d PQ=2 (pops issued two cycles ahead from shadows, +1 cycle per link hop, full rate) and PF=1 push pin flops; the old-flow ot_qkvd_sbuf view (clock insertion 505/280 ps, unregistered pop cone, M4-M6 pin faces) made the q10 spine run away (L 2.5 ns, FF hold -216 on input-port -> register paths) and left 35 parent-over-child shorts
